professionalSummary.text: Prepared and quality-checked change requests for eleven fortnightly releases of a consumer banking app, ensuring rollback plans, test evidence, and named ownership were included before submission to the change advisory board.

professionalSummary.text: Recorded change advisory board decisions in the change tool and maintained the release calendar, publishing outcomes to engineering squads after the board chair made the go/no-go decision.

professionalSummary.text: Authored post-release summaries for each cycle, documenting incidents, rollbacks, and open items for the operations manager's review.

professionalSummary.text: Documented known limitations and hand-over conditions for each release cycle as part of the change management process.
professionalSummary.witness: Responsibilities included change-request preparation, board record keeping, pre-freeze coordination and post-release reporting for the mobile release train over about a year.
